title: OmniGuard SOC Telemetry & Graph Schemas
description: Standardized data schemas for VerifyEye (ingress phishing), SpectraC2 (beaconing egress), and Neo4j graph entity correlation with Tier 2 nodes (Process, URL) and Tier 3 concept properties.

VerifyEyeAlert.description: Alert payload emitted by VerifyEye Chrome Extension / Ingress crawler when phishing or brand impersonation is detected.

timestamp.description: Epoch timestamp (seconds with microsecond precision) of detection

host_id.description: Unique identifier / hostname of endpoint device (Host node in Neo4j)

user.description: Logged-in user account identifier, if available (User node in Neo4j)

src_ip.description: Local / egress IP address of the client machine

target_url.description: Full URL of the flagged phishing website (materialized into URL node in Neo4j)

domain.description: Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) being visited (Domain node in Neo4j)

action_endpoint.description: Form action URL where intercepted credentials would be submitted

brand_target.description: Corporate brand identified by YOLOv8/pHash (e.g., 'Microsoft 365', 'Okta', 'Google Workspace')

confidence.description: Object detection model confidence score (0.0 to 1.0)

phash_distance.description: Hamming distance of visual perceptual hash against authentic brand template

input_frozen.description: Whether client-side script successfully locked input fields and blocked form submission

mitre_technique.description: Mapped MITRE ATT&CK technique code (e.g. T1566.002 Spearphishing Link, T1056 Input Capture)

raw_metadata.description: Optional telemetry details (DOM tree signature, bounding box coordinates, TLS certificate issuer)

SpectraC2Alert.description: Alert payload emitted by SpectraC2 beacon detector on encrypted network traffic.

beacon_interval.description: Dominant periodicity in seconds computed via FFT power spectral density

pid.description: Originating process PID if endpoint EDR telemetry is available

neo4j_graph_schema.description: Neo4j property graph topology. Incorporates 7 primary nodes (Tier 1 core + Tier 2 Process & URL) with Tier 3 concepts represented cleanly as node and edge properties.

Host.description: Physical or virtual machine endpoint (Asset and Network Segment concepts embedded as properties).

properties.is_critical_asset: BOOLEAN (Tier 3 Asset concept: flags high-value targets)
properties.cve_list: LIST<STRING> (Tier 3 Vulnerability concept: known unpatched CVEs on this host, e.g. ['CVE-2024-21413'])

User.description: Identity principal (Account concept embedded as properties).

properties.is_service_account: BOOLEAN (Tier 3 Account concept: true for automated identities)

IP.description: Internal or external IPv4/IPv6 network endpoint.

properties.subnet: STRING (Tier 3 Network Segment concept: CIDR prefix, e.g. '10.0.1.0/24')

Domain.description: Fully Qualified Domain Name queried via DNS or TLS SNI.

properties.is_sinkholed: BOOLEAN (true if internal DNS has redirected to sinkhole)

URL.description: Tier 2 Node: Explicit web resource link intercepted by VerifyEye. Links disparate hosts attacked with the same lure.

properties.brand_target: STRING (brand target flagged by YOLOv8, e.g. 'Microsoft 365')

Process.description: Tier 2 Node: Running execution unit on a host (File/Payload concept embedded as sha256 property). Crucial for Stage 3 lateral movement and process injection.

properties.process_id: STRING (composite unique key: host_id + ':' + pid, e.g. 'HOST-CORP-WKSTN-10:4920')
properties.name: STRING (executable binary name, e.g. 'powershell.exe', 'sliver-agent.exe', 'lsass.exe')
properties.sha256: STRING (Tier 3 File/Payload concept: cryptographic hash of binary file)
properties.file_path: STRING (Tier 3 File concept: path on disk, e.g. 'C:\Windows\Temp\sliver.exe')
properties.user: STRING (user account security context under which process executed)

Alert.description: Correlated high-confidence security event emitted by VerifyEye, SpectraC2, or EDR.

relationships.description: Direct alert attribution to affected physical/virtual host
VerifyEye alert pinpointing specific phishing URL
Alert attributing compromise to specific user identity
Hierarchical link connecting specific URL path to its parent Domain node
Host browser navigated to URL. Multi-host links reveal enterprise campaign breadth.
Host performed DNS resolution for domain
Network connection established from host to external IP
Host operating system spawned execution process
Specific process established network egress connection to external IP
Malicious process performed memory injection into another process (Stage 3 lateral movement)
External IP address resolves to or serves specified Domain

create_constraints: CREATE CONSTRAINT unique_host_id IF NOT EXISTS FOR (h:Host) REQUIRE h.host_id IS UNIQUE;
CREATE CONSTRAINT unique_username IF NOT EXISTS FOR (u:User) REQUIRE u.username IS UNIQUE;
CREATE CONSTRAINT unique_ip_address IF NOT EXISTS FOR (i:IP) REQUIRE i.address IS UNIQUE;
CREATE CONSTRAINT unique_domain_name IF NOT EXISTS FOR (d:Domain) REQUIRE d.domain_name IS UNIQUE;
CREATE CONSTRAINT unique_url IF NOT EXISTS FOR (url:URL) REQUIRE url.url IS UNIQUE;
CREATE CONSTRAINT unique_process_id IF NOT EXISTS FOR (p:Process) REQUIRE p.process_id IS UNIQUE;
CREATE CONSTRAINT unique_alert_id IF NOT EXISTS FOR (a:Alert) REQUIRE a.alert_id IS UNIQUE;
CREATE INDEX alert_timestamp_idx IF NOT EXISTS FOR (a:Alert) ON (a.timestamp);
CREATE INDEX host_subnet_idx IF NOT EXISTS FOR (h:Host) ON (h.subnet);

verifyeye_payload.description: VerifyEye intercepted zero-hour credential theft page visually impersonating Microsoft 365. Keystroke inputs frozen.
